evidence_flagged_dangerous.message: Google Safe Browsing — the list Chrome, Firefox and Safari use to warn people — marks this site as unsafe.

evidence_flagged_phishing.message: Security services have received reports that this site tricks people out of passwords or card details.

evidence_on_blocklists.message: Security researchers have already put this site on lists of scam and spam sites.

evidence_threat_reports.message: Security researchers mention this site in their reports about attacks.

evidence_spreads_malware.message: This site has been caught spreading programs that infect computers and phones.

evidence_imitates_brand.message: The address looks like a well-known company's, but it doesn't belong to that company.

evidence_lookalike_letters.message: Some letters in the address only look like ordinary ones. That is how the real address is hidden.

evidence_fake_brand_address.message: A famous name sits at the start of the address, but the site itself belongs to someone else.

evidence_copies_brand_icon.message: The page shows a real company's icon but lives at an unrelated address — a common trick for stealing logins.

evidence_no_https.message: Anything you type on this site is sent without protection and can be intercepted.

evidence_missing_protections.message: The site skips basic protections that real companies normally set up.

evidence_raw_ip_address.message: Real companies give their sites a name. Scam pages often use a bare number instead.

evidence_unusual_connection.message: The site uses an unusual way to connect that ordinary websites rarely need.

evidence_hidden_destination.message: The link hides the address it really leads to.

evidence_very_new_site.message: Scam sites usually live just a few days, so a brand-new address is a warning sign.

evidence_scam_words.message: The address contains words like “login” or “secure” that scammers add to look official.

evidence_carries_personal_data.message: The link itself carries your email or a sign-in key. Anyone who sees the link can take them.

evidence_long_complex_address.message: The address is long and tangled, so it's hard to see where it really leads.

evidence_many_redirects.message: The link jumps through several sites before landing here — often to hide where it really goes.

evidence_risky_ending.message: The address ends in a zone (like .xyz or .top) where scam sites are especially common.

evidence_risky_registrar.message: The site was registered through a service that scammers often choose.

evidence_random_name.message: The name looks like a random jumble — typical of sites churned out for one-off scams.

evidence_detector_suspicious.message: Our detector, trained on thousands of real and scam sites, finds this one similar to the scams.

evidence_not_a_real_business.message: The site has no working email. Real companies almost always do.

evidence_shifty_setup.message: The site keeps switching the servers it runs on — a trick that makes scam sites hard to shut down.

evidence_padded_address.message: Extra parts are stacked in front of the real name so it's hard to spot.

evidence_shared_hosting.message: Anyone can make a site on this free service in a minute, scammers included.

evidence_on_cleanway_list.message: Cleanway's own list of known scam sites includes this one.

evidence_site_not_found.message: There is no working site at this address right now. Check the spelling.

evidence_unreachable_abroad.message: Our server abroad couldn't open this site, so the page itself wasn't checked.

evidence_checks_incomplete.message: Not every check finished in time, so this verdict rests on fewer signs.

evidence_user_content_platform.message: Anyone can publish pages on this service. We can't vouch for this particular page.

evidence_invalid_address.message: The address itself is broken. It may be a trap set for people who copy links.

evidence_private_network.message: Ordinary public websites don't lead there, so we didn't open it.

evidence_ai_second_look.message: When the signs point both ways, an AI model reviews them and may adjust the verdict a little.

evidence_well_known_site.message: This is one of the well-known sites we recognize as genuine.

evidence_popular_site.message: This site is on the list of the world's most visited sites. That counts in its favor, but other warning signs still matter.

evidence_detector_safe.message: Our detector, trained on thousands of real and scam sites, finds this one similar to real sites.

evidence_on_your_trusted_list.message: You added this site to your trusted sites yourself.
